Nivin Pauly's New Film Begins Shooting with Rukmini Vasanth

Filming has commenced for Nivin Pauly's upcoming movie, tentatively titled NP51. The project also stars Rukmini Vasanth, marking her debut in Malayalam cinema, and Aju Varghese. The announcement was made as shooting began for the film.
